# Filmuniversität Babelsberg KONRAD WOLF

> > Germany's leading film university offering specialized education in cinema, television, and digital media production.

Filmuniversität Babelsberg KONRAD WOLF is located in Potsdam-Babelsberg, the historic heart of German film production. The university provides comprehensive programs in film directing, cinematography, screenwriting, production design, animation, and media studies through its LSF (Lehre, Studium, Forschung) student portal powered by HISinOne.

## Student Portal & Course Management

- [LSF Student Portal](https://lsf.filmuniversitaet.de/qisserver/rds?state=user&type=0): Main student information system for course registration, schedules, grades, and academic administration at Filmuniversität Babelsberg
